findings.finding: The child's file names the child, but the inherited root acceptance names LEGSMOKE-1083 and says "one new Markdown file"; three children each adding a marker cannot all satisfy it literally.
findings.answer: Recorded as Departure 1 for the architect: the plan reads the root's acceptance per child (the marker names LEGSMOKE-1088, per the smoke/ convention) and the completion summary names the decision; the planner edits no spec.

findings.finding: The derivation from an empty child spec is unstated, and the title's "upgrade rehearsal push" names a mechanic the marker-file acceptance never checks.
findings.answer: plan.md opens with the root spec quoted whole, the convention files cited by path and content, and every derived point labelled an assumption; the rehearsal is stated as a proof-driver mechanic (the handoff commit held unpushed, pushed on the driver's message) with R2 and D16 covering the push discipline; a repository-visible requirement, if any, is named as the architect's to supply.

findings.finding: "First line names LEGSMOKE-1088" is not machine-checkable; the repository documents the byte-exact check set it must become.
findings.answer: Constants record lineOne, 81 bytes, sha256, git blob sha1, first and last bytes; C2 is the full set (wc -l, tail -c1 | od, wc -c, sha256sum, head -1 string-equal, grep -c, no CR, no BOM) read with readCommand at an explicit SHA.

findings.finding: `<sha>` is left open in the proof commands; the first push is the planner's handoff, and the approved head must come from GitHub, not review.json.
findings.answer: The Heads table names planHead, firstCodeHead (recorded in implement.json, read for every content criterion), approvedHead (the APPROVED review's commit_id on GitHub) and mergeSha (production check); review.json's field is named readHead.

findings.finding: A negative control anchored at the base `main` SHA loses meaning when main advances; a pre-seeded fixture commit would need two bases B and F.
findings.answer: B and F are recorded literally (both 6d843f28; no pre-Legion commit on this branch, verified by jj diff --from main@origin --to @- empty), the 404 control reads at ?ref=B and ?ref=main, pre-state is the invalidating facts of D10, and branchInvariant/forkPointRecheck run each phase (D4).

findings.finding: No CI or mergeability criterion, and a `.fail-me` probe as a control would be snapshotted into the next commit (no root .gitignore).
findings.answer: C3 requires gate and check success at every code head with the push and pull_request pairs cited (D12); the gate control is mergeStateStatus BLOCKED at a zero-check trailered handoff head; no role creates .fail-me (D11).

findings.finding: The inherited "one appended line if review asks" allowance has no authorizer, text, hash update or deadline, and READY refuses paths above the approved head.
findings.answer: D2 fixes the trigger (a CHANGES_REQUESTED review containing `append one more line` with one inline comment naming the text), the default text L2 with its two-line constants, the one-append cap, line 1 unchanged, and that an append after approval is a new review round that re-approves appendHead; secondLineDiscriminator selects the state at judging time.
